summary: Phase 147A independently reconstructed PCAE's full strategic state from primary sources -- frozen contracts under docs/contracts/, each track's own closing/certification report, direct file-listing, and live pcae runtime inspect/pcae push check output -- rather than inferring the next chapter from phase numbering or trusting any single predecessor's summary. Confirmed docs/ROADMAP.md and docs/ROADMAP_REGISTRY.md remain self-disclosed stale relative to PROJECT_STATUS.md's Current Phase section, unchanged since Phase 144I. Corrected a stale belief that Track 135 (Whole-Lifecycle Independent Verification) paused at 135F and Track 136 (Stage 3 Companion Executable Schema) stopped at 136U: both tracks in fact ran to full completion (136 through 136AY plus a closing final-review document; 135 through Stage-3-authority-cutover and atomic-publication-rehearsal phases) and converged into the Phase 137V/Typed Authority Model line. Confirmed BR-005 (69A-69O) is capability-complete -- governed promote/rollback, the only root-repository-mutating commands anywhere in the project -- but stalled after the read-only 69P phase, with Phase Activation Governance still unresolved. Confirmed GLP-PILOT-C6 remains at Stage 2 with Stage 3 Readiness independently certified (142I) but Stage 3 Implementation not begun, blocked solely on the still-undischarged GAC-001 Sec.9 Stage 6 governance-process decision, a human decision outside this or any PCAE phase's authority to resolve or simulate. Identified the authority-evaluation gap, informally C-1 (no eligible_authority model exists on Decision Templates, so authority_basis_claimed/assurance_level remain correctly disclosed as absent rather than fabricated), as the one capability named as a standing, correctly-undischarged deferral by three independent chapters: IWPC-001 Sec.29/Sec.31, CHGR-001/Chapter 146, and, in substance, GLP-PILOT-C6's GAC-001 Sec.9. Evaluated five candidates -- the C-1 authority-evaluation model, GLP-PILOT-C6 Stage 3 resumption, a standalone Phase 107A execution-capability gap re-derivation, roadmap-tracking reconciliation, and Runtime/Permission Broker execution capability -- against architectural value, principle consistency, runtime- and authority-boundary interaction, dependency readiness, implementation complexity, verification burden, and certification implications. Selected the C-1 authority-evaluation model as Chapter 147's objective: every prerequisite contract (IWC-001, IWPC-001, CHGR-001, PEC-001) is already frozen and independently verified, it touches no runtime path, it preserves every existing governance and ownership boundary, and it does not fold in GLP-PILOT-C6's GAC-001 Sec.9 question or Runtime/Permission Broker execution capability, both of which remain independent, disclosed, unscheduled candidates. Defined Chapter 147's scope, exclusions, an eight-phase governance sequence (147A-147H mirroring GLP-001 Sec.6.1), and named risks, principally the discipline risk of authority evaluation drifting into authority enforcement, which IWPC-REQ-002/003 explicitly forbid this contract family from inventing. Verdict: NEXT STRATEGIC CAPABILITY IDENTIFIED. Full detail in docs/PHASE_147A_NEXT_STRATEGIC_CAPABILITY_ARCHITECTURE_REASSESSMENT.md.
